messages:
Renee (Recruiter): Omar accepted our offer for 2026-04-12. He mentioned he'll be traveling internationally 4/8-4/11 and his EAD renewal is still pending (filed 3/28). Questions: can he travel? can we still do I-9 remotely?
Priya - People Ops: Travel during a pending EAD renewal can be risky. If Omar departs US before adjudication, re-entry could be denied depending on his underlying status. We need to confirm his underlying classification (e.g., pending adjustment, asylum, etc.). @Legal-Team - advise on re-entry risk and whether the company can accept a passport + I-797C for remote I-9 in this case.
Legal-Team: Quick note: company cannot guarantee re-entry outcomes. If Omar has a pending adjustment (I-485) with AP, travel is safer if AP is in place. For EAD renewals alone, re-entry is high-risk. For I-9: we can accept photocopies only as temporary evidence for remote hires IF local law permits and subject to later in-person physical verification within 3 business days of US return. We'll confirm exact wording.
Omar N (New Hire): I filed renewal because my current EAD expires 4/10. I do have pending adjustment (I-485) but no AP yet. I can postpone travel if needed. I wasn't aware it was high-risk.
Priya - People Ops: Ok Omar - best to postpone travel until after your EAD is adjudicated or AP is in hand. If you must travel, consult your lawyer and we should log the risk acknowledgment from you. Also: we cannot complete payroll/onboarding paperwork until I-9 physical verification is done in person or accepted per remote exception.
Carlos (Payroll): Payroll note: without completed I-9 and valid work auth we cannot set up direct deposit or benefits. We can create a payroll profile but no payments will be processed. If EAD arrives mid-cycle and we have all docs before cutoff, we can retro-pay.
Renee (Recruiter): Omar says delaying trip is possible. He prefers finishing onboarding first. Also asks about equity vesting start date if his paid start shifts. Any guidance?
Priya - People Ops: Equity/start-date stuff: if we need to push paid start we can keep hire date as original for equity vesting only with manager approval; payroll start and benefits would follow actual paid start. That needs sign-off from People Ops and Compensation. I'll route that if needed.
Legal-Team: We can draft a travel acknowledgment and contingent start addendum. The addendum will state: unpaid orientation allowed, remote access limited, I-9 in-person verification required before first paid day, and we won't be liable for immigration outcomes. It will also note any vesting adjustments are separate.
Omar N (New Hire): I prefer to delay travel. Also: I already uploaded I-797C and passport scans to the portal earlier today.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Omar N: i797c_april_upload.pdf (HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: Thanks Omar. Action plan:
- Omar: postpone travel or sign the risk acknowledgment if travel required.
- Renee: send contingent start addendum (orientation-only until clearance) and travel ack draft today.
- Carlos: flag payroll for retro-pay possibility and withhold benefits activation until docs verified.
- Legal-Team: post finalized addendum wording here once ready.
Carlos (Payroll): Also flag: SSN - if Omar hasn't received SSN yet, we need to start payroll but will wait for SSN before tax withholding setup. If SSN pending, please notify payroll ASAP.
Omar N (New Hire): I have an SSN card already. Good to go there.
Priya - People Ops: Great. Renee, please send addendum and mark start as "orientation-only" for 4/12 with conversion to paid once EAD is received and I-9 in-person completed. Omar, we'll also put a calendar block for an in-person I-9 appointment the week of 4/13 so it's ready if your EAD arrives.
Renee (Recruiter): Will do. I'll include a clause about premium processing reimbursement per policy if Omar opts and provides receipts.
Legal-Team: Draft posted: "Contingent Start & Travel Acknowledgment" (we'll attach to the offer). Please review and confirm before sending.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: "Confirm Omar EAD status" on 2026-04-11 09:00
Omar N (New Hire): Thanks everyone. I'll delay travel and watch for the addendum. Appreciate the clear plan. :thumbsup:
Priya - People Ops: Closing notes: once EAD clears and I-9 is done in person, payroll will retro-pay to the orientation start date if docs are in prior to payroll cutoff. We'll confirm final payroll timing after legal signs the addendum.
